variants.prompt: In a dimly lit, plush boudoir, exotic beauty reclines on a velvet chaise, raven tresses spilling across crimson silk. Emerald eyes smolder with desire as she gazes into the camera lens, olive skin glowing under soft candlelight. A sheer black negligee clings to her curves, strappy stilettos crossed at the ankles, delicate silver choker accentuating her slender neck. The shallow depth of field blurs the ornate furniture, focusing attention on the striking model's sensual pose.
